notes.title: Introducing Five New AgeOfGames Bundles on Steam!
notes.notes:
The New Bundles:

[b]AgeOfGames - OldSchool Turn-Based Strategy Bundle[/b]

Immerse yourself in our classic strategy games! This bundle gathers all our beloved turn-based strategy titles, perfect for players who enjoy tactical depth and strategic planning.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597132/16a96d2f956fb5d7282a24ece39d3b3d35334c0b.jpg[/img]

[b]The Etrom World Bundle[/b]

Explore the dark, immersive world of Etrom and Chroma Wars. This bundle combines two games with rich storylines and intense gameplay set in our mysterious universe, which has birthed video games, novels, short stories and so much more still to come.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597132/88fa7e9cbd08054cbcc1c2a6d1fbe484ba533ce1.jpg[/img]

[b]The King Island Bundle[/b]

Dive into the entire King Island series, including the latest installment, King Towers. This bundle is a must-have for fans of action-packed adventures with a side of comedy. The King Island series reveal the story of Kaptivo’s journey through three ARPGs - King Towers is our only Tower Defence game currently available on the store!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597132/c4e0a11bb5803425dab0c6bc14f531c158690356.jpg[/img]

[b]The Eukarion Continent Bundle[/b]

Journey through the world of Eukarion, where Fantasy Kommander and the Eukarion Tales series live and breathe fantasy. Set in a shared universe, this bundle delivers an epic fantasy experience with classic RPGs as well as our strategic masterpiece!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597132/1e4b829a7ddf6a06e52e7eceb4407ab79a055ff1.jpg[/img]

[b]The AgeOfGames OldSchool ARPG Bundle[/b]

This collection gathers AgeOfGames’ classic indie action-RPG. Featuring nostalgic visuals and hours of immersive gameplay, this bundle is perfect for those looking to relive the charm of old-school RPGs

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597132/af4a1e4fa681668bbaeebf4810c344bce671d6af.jpg[/img]

[b]The Original:[/b]

[b]AgeOfGames - Millennium Artifacts Bundle[/b]

Already available, Discover a grand collection of games that have stood the test of time. This bundle is your gateway to some of AgeOfGames' most cherished titles, all in one place with a generous discount.

Each bundle offers a unique selection of games at a great value, letting you explore the best of AgeOfGames in one purchase. Check them out on Steam now!

notes.title: Fantasy Kommander Eukarion Wars is now LIVE on Steam!
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that Fantasy Kommander: Eukarion Wars is now available on Steam!

Developed by us and released for the first time in 2013, now in collaboration with Troglobytes Games and Untold Games, Fantasy Kommander is back!

Our turn-based strategy game invites you to command armies, unravel captivating storylines, and relive a classic experience with pre-rendered 90s-style graphics.

Special Launch Price: $4.99 (38% off from $7.99) - Limited Time Offer!

Immerse Yourself in Epic Battles:

Embark on a medieval-inspired isometric fantasy journey, mastering the intricacies of the Archangelus tactical simulation system on hexagonal maps.

Discover Mysterious Enemies:

Follow the guidance of Emperor Karl and the Grand Council of Mages as you uncover a mysterious enemy plotting in the shadows. Lead Heroes – Humans, Elves, and Dwarves – to triumph across the Empire of Adamantia and uncharted lands.

Conquer Realms, Be Forever Victorious:

Engage in multiple battles, each offering gold, fame points, and various benefits for successful completion. With a complex battle system, immersive narrative, and over 70 unique units, Fantasy Kommander promises an unparalleled gaming experience.

Don't miss out on this epic adventure! Grab your copy now on Steam and lead your armies to victory!

If you haven't played Chroma Wars yet, it's on a 50% discount right now!

notes.title: A Triple Treat this Steam Winter Sale – Etrom, Eukarion Tales 2, and Chroma Wars
notes.notes:
Greetings Adventurer, 

Over the last year we’ve been able to introduce our retro games to what feels like a whole new world. 

Today, we want  to invite you to embark on  thrilling journeys and tactical battles as we put our entire catalog on sale this Steam Winter Sale! For a limited time, dive into the worlds of Etrom, Eukarion Tales 2, and Chroma Wars for 55% off!

[b]Etrom - Dive into a Dystopian Epic:[/b]

Uncover the secrets of a post-apocalyptic world in Etrom. Immerse yourself in a gripping narrative, where your choices shape the destiny of the protagonist. With intense combat, magical abilities, and a vast, open world to explore, Etrom promises an unforgettable adventure.

[b]Eukarion Tales 2 - Forge Your Destiny:[/b]

Embark on a heroic quest in Eukarion Tales 2, a classic RPG where your decisions impact the unfolding story. With a rich fantasy setting, diverse characters, and strategic turn-based battles, this game offers an immersive experience for fans of epic tales and strategic gameplay.

[b]Chroma Wars - Command Your Forces:[/b]

Strategists, assemble! Chroma Wars invites you to the battlefield, where tactics and cunning are your greatest allies. Command an army of unique units with distinct abilities, engage in challenging missions, and conquer the vibrant world of Chroma Wars. It's time to prove your strategic prowess!

Whether you're a fan of RPGs, tactical battles, or immersive storytelling, we hope to have your retro game fix covered.

Happy Holidays!
